omnix_agent_approvals.request_payload: keep; execution_key is matched among one run's approvals, already narrowed by the run index
omnix_agent_plan_revisions.payload: keep; semantic_review is read from one run's plan revisions
omnix_agent_run_commands.payload: keep; task_revision_id and quality_stage filter one run's pending commands
omnix_agent_run_events.payload: keep; tool_call_id containment is evaluated on one run's events of one type, already narrowed by idx_omnix_agent_events_type (WP-7.4)
omnix_assets.metadata: keep; filename is projected in audiobook source listings, never filtered
omnix_audiobook_annotations.evidence: keep; classifier_analysis_job_id is read within one project's annotations
omnix_audiobook_projects.settings: keep; settings fields are read and updated for one project by id
omnix_audiobook_render_batches.completed: keep; containment check on one batch selected by id
omnix_audiobook_source_revisions.metadat: keep; filename is projected for one project's revisions
omnix_characters.profile: keep; display_name orders one workspace's characters (keyset paging, WP-5.5); promote to a column if character counts grow past thousands
omnix_chat_messages.metadata: keep; assistant_turn_id and reply_to_message_id are matched within one session, narrowed by the session/position index
omnix_jobs.input_payload: indexed; session_id has the expression index idx on (workspace_id, input_payload->>'session_id') for chat jobs; awaiting_plan_approval and submission_id filter rows already selected by job type and status
omnix_jobs.metadata: keep; compat_contract fields are evaluated on claim candidates already selected by status and availability
omnix_memory_v2_derived_policy_envelopes: keep; containment is evaluated after the (principal, owner) filter of one owner's envelopes
omnix_memory_v2_search_index_entries.evi: keep; containment is evaluated after the (principal, owner) filter of one owner's entries
omnix_module_records.payload: indexed for chat summaries (session_id, migration 0111); character_id, proposal_id, error and created_at filter one record type of one workspace, already narrowed by the module index
omnix_retention_policies.metadata: keep; maintenance_only is read from a table of about a dozen policies
omnix_runtime_nodes.metadata: keep; workspace_id is read from the few live runtime nodes
omnix_trading_strategy_events.payload: keep; entry_time orders one strategy's events in paper analytics; promote if the analytics read becomes a hot path
